channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula termina semana bem na foto
item.description: Although the opposition tried to weaken the government by rejecting Jorge Messias’ STF nomination and overturning the veto on a law reducing penalties for coup plotters, Lula reversed the situation with unexpected support from Donald Trump and André Mendonça, figures admired by Bolsonaro. This alliance allowed the president to regain political ground, turning an apparent setback into a display of strength and negotiation skill.

item.title: Governo prevê R$ 130 bi para novos contratos de energia; Enel em SP não é contemplada
item.description: The Lula government is set to announce R$130 billion in investments for the renewal of electricity distribution contracts with 16 companies, including two that have already been updated. Enel São Paulo was not included in this round of renewals, despite being one of the country's largest distributors.

item.title: Lula ganha atestado de vigor de Trump, o ídolo do bolsonarismo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro attempted to attack President Lula by associating him with the image of being 'old' and 'outdated,' but Lula's meeting with Donald Trump in Washington created an unexpected contrast. Trump publicly praised Lula as a 'very dynamic' president, providing an unlikely endorsement from a central figure of Bolsonarism, which undermined Flávio's narrative.

item.title: Partido de Ciro Nogueira adia evento em que oficializaria apoio a Tarcísio em SP
item.description: The Progressistas (PP) postponed its official event endorsing Governor Tarcísio de Freitas' re-election bid in São Paulo after Senator Ciro Nogueira, the party president, became a target of a Federal Police operation under 'Compliance Zero'. Investigations allege Nogueira received undue advantages from banker Daniel Vorcaro, including monthly payments of up to R$500,000, luxury flights, and a constitutional amendment drafted by Banco Master. Despite the postponement, the PP maintains its support for Tarcísio in the October elections.

item.title: Reunião com Trump e operação contra Ciro dão ânimo a pré-campanha de Lula
item.description: Lula's meeting with Donald Trump at the White House and the Federal Police operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro, boosted the president's pre-campaign. These events were seen as political gains that energize Lula's base and weaken opposition coordination. The action against Nogueira, PP leader in the Senate, is viewed as a strategic blow to a key figure in Bolsonarism.

item.title: Congresso tem seus problemas, mas evitou estrago maior de Lula
item.description: Congress defeated President Lula in two key votes: it overturned his veto on the dosimetry bill and rejected the nomination of Jorge Messias to the Supreme Court. Despite criticism from the PT and its digital militias, Congress avoided greater institutional damage by asserting its independence from the Executive.

item.title: Trump diz que Lula é 'inteligente' e um 'bom homem' após encontro na Casa Branca
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump praised Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following a three-hour meeting at the White House, calling him a 'good man' and 'intelligent'. Trump described the meeting as 'great' to reporters.

item.title: O movimento de Lula e as investigações que podem complicar Davi Alcolumbre na PF
item.description: Lula's ministers, José Múcio Monteiro and José Guimarães, met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to assure him that Lula bears no responsibility for ongoing Federal Police investigations into him, which involve Banco Master, INSS, and the Carbono Oculto operation. Despite promising a reconciliation meeting with Lula, Alcolumbre remains skeptical, claiming he will be targeted for retaliation by the PT following Jorge Messias's defeat in the STF selection. Investigations against Alcolumbre, previously low-priority, have intensified due to increased questioning of informants.

item.title: Ativismo judicial do Congresso Nacional
item.description: The text criticizes the frequent accusation of judicial activism against the STF, arguing it is often used as political rhetoric to delegitimize unfavorable decisions without technical basis. It proposes that true judicial activism is shifting to the Legislature, particularly in the INSS and Organized Crime CPIs, which exercise judicial powers without respecting legality, procedures, or STF rulings, thus constituting congressional judicial activism that violates the separation of powers.

item.title: Após ‘passar pano’ para Ciro Nogueira, Flávio cobra instalação de CPI do Banco Master
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for President, took to social media to demand the installation of the Banco Master CPI, after being widely criticized for issuing a formal statement about the ties between former Minister Ciro Nogueira and banker Daniel Vorcaro. His move is seen as an attempt to distance himself from accusations of ‘giving a pass’ to Bolsonaro allies, while politically capitalizing on the Banco Master scandal.

item.title: Possível jogo duplo de Daniel Vorcaro na delação provoca reações no STF
item.description: Banker Daniel Vorcaro, imprisoned for two months, faces suspicions of playing a double game in his plea bargain attempt, retaining his current legal team despite family pressure to hire a prominent São Paulo lawyer. A photo published by Estadão showing his lawyer conversing with a TSE minister has raised investigator concerns about potential collusion with former allies to undermine the probe into billion-dollar frauds at Master. Justice André Mendonça has directed that only he will communicate with Vorcaro’s lawyer in the case files, signaling STF caution amid suspicions of maneuvers to sabotage the cooperation agreement.

item.title: Frase do dia
item.description: Lula detailed his meeting with Trump following their encounter at the White House, stating that the operation against Senator Ciro Nogueira was based on a decision by Minister André Mendonça and carried out by the Federal Police, adding that he hopes all those investigated are found innocent.

item.title: Por que operação contra Ciro Nogueira pode ameaçar delação de Vorcaro?
item.description: The new phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira, shows that investigations into the Banco Master scandal will continue advancing regardless of a plea deal with banker Daniel Vorcaro. Criminalists say the PF and STF Minister André Mendonça have signaled they will not accept a timid or information-poor cooperation proposal. Vorcaro’s initial plea offer, submitted a day before the operation, was criticized for omitting details about authorities like Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, despite evidence of their meetings.

item.title: 'Não é do grupo': Casemiro freia expectativa sobre Endrick na Copa, e pede cautela com jovem
item.description: Casemiro warned that Endrick is still not part of the Brazil national team's core group and urged caution regarding the excessive pressure on the 19-year-old forward. He acknowledged the player's potential but stressed that the responsibility to solve the team's offensive issues cannot be placed on someone still establishing himself in European football. The Manchester United midfielder emphasized the need to 'shield' young players from external expectations to protect their development.

item.title: Como a investigação sobre escândalo do Master atingiu Ciro Nogueira, um dos líderes do Centrão
item.description: The Federal Police conducted searches at the residence of Senator Ciro Nogueira, president of the Progressistas party, as part of Operation Compliance, due to suspected involvement in the Master scandal involving banker Daniel Vorcaro. Nogueira, a former Bolsonaro Cabinet chief and leader of the Centrão bloc, is alleged to have received undue advantages through his ties to the banker. A ruling by Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça suggests the investigation may extend to other high-level public officials.

item.title: O lamentável retrocesso no projeto de despoluição do Rio Pinheiros, em São Paulo
item.description: The Novo Rio Pinheiros project, launched in 2019 with a R$1.5 billion investment, advanced through 550,000 sewage connections, five treatment plants, and removal of 700,000 tons of debris, leading to visible improvements such as the return of fish and turtles. However, in recent years, revitalization efforts have stalled, causing foul odors and increased trash to return, confirmed by CETESB through rising DBO levels, reversing earlier environmental gains.

item.title: Veja Essa: Shakira, Romeu Zema e Luma de Oliveira
item.description: The excerpt includes statements from Shakira about her Copacabana show, Romeu Zema criticizing the left’s view on child labor, Luma de Oliveira defending her children against Eike Batista’s remarks, and quotes from Nicolás Maduro Guerra, Ruy Guerra, Spike Lee, Tony Ramos, Evangeline Lilly, Bernardo Bessa, Daniel Alves, and Jacqueline Bisset. There is no explicit focus on 2026 election candidates, though Zema is noted as a pre-candidate for presidency.

item.title: Novas pesquisas alertam: o estresse provoca mais danos ao organismo do que se imaginava
item.description: Chronic stress is reaching record levels globally, driven by political, economic, and social tensions, with Brazil reporting that four in ten citizens experience anxiety. A recent study found that about 30% of Brazilians face stress and anxiety as their most frequent emotions, particularly among youth, who report feeling more isolated and uncertain about the future. Despite the national image of joy, experts describe a reality of 'active resilience,' indicating that Brazilians persistently cope with adversity — but at significant cost to mental health.

item.title: Vorcaro quer devolver R$ 40 bilhões, mas só em 10 anos
item.description: Daniel Vorcaro's defense proposed returning R$ 40 billion over 10 years as part of a plea bargain, but the STF and PGR consider the timeline too long and ineffective for immediate public fund recovery. The defense strategy aims to gain time to seek procedural nullities, while investigators argue the excessive installment plan undermines a core pillar of the plea bargain law. The documents have not yet been received by Minister André Mendonça, with analysis expected between June and July 2026, raising concerns about potential leaks of sensitive data ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Lula acumula 155 dias fora do Brasil em 45 viagens desde 2023
item.description: President Lula has spent 155 days abroad since 2023 across 45 trips, including 17 days in 2026, highlighted by a three-hour meeting with Donald Trump in Washington on trade, tariffs, and geopolitics. After previously criticizing Trump, Lula adopted a positive tone during the encounter, praising the Brazil-U.S. relationship as a global example and joking about Trump's smile.

item.title: Trump diz que Lula é um 'homem bom' e 'sujeito inteligente' após encontro
item.description: Trump praised Lula as a 'good man' and 'intelligent guy' following their White House meeting, highlighting constructive trade talks and plans to expand U.S.-Brazil commerce. Lula said he left 'very satisfied', expressing optimism about resolving tariffs through a 30-day working group, while acknowledging persistent commercial disagreements between the two governments.

item.title: 'Tensão' sobre tarifas e surpresa em terras raras: os bastidores da reunião entre Lula e Trump na Casa Branca
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump at the White House aimed to prevent new U.S. tariffs on Brazilian goods, with the Brazilian government viewing the outcome as a success due to the creation of a 30-day working group on trade issues. Despite tension caused by U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer, who argued for maintaining Brazilian tariffs on U.S. imports, the only point of disagreement was tariffs, and no joint statement was issued after the meeting.

item.title: Perfil de direita faz vídeos de IA sobre mascote das eleições
item.description: The YouTube channel 'Canta Direita' published two AI-generated videos criticizing the official 2026 election mascot 'Pilili' through musical parodies. The first video references the 'L' gesture associated with Lula, while the second attacks Supreme Court Minister Cármen Lúcia, calling her 'Carmetchen'. The videos have received 1,415 and 625 views respectively and have been shared on social media platforms like X.

item.title: Aliados do governo apostam em operação contra Ciro e reunião Lula-Trump para conter narrativa de fragilidade após derrota de Messias
item.description: Lula met with Donald Trump for three hours at the Brazilian embassy in Washington, where Trump called him 'very dynamic' on social media. Lula posted photos of the meeting on Instagram. The meeting comes as government allies push operations against Ciro Gomes and seek to counter narratives of weakness following Messias's defeat.

item.title: Tarifas, minerais críticos, crime, Irã: veja os temas, avanços e bastidores da reunião de Lula e Trump
item.description: Lula and Trump met at the White House and described the meeting as productive, focusing on U.S. import tariffs on Brazilian goods, while also discussing Iran, organized financial crime, and critical minerals. Both governments’ teams will have 30 days to advance trade negotiations. Lula said he returned to Brazil more optimistic and emphasized progress on previously taboo topics, though Pix and labeling criminal factions as terrorist organizations were not addressed.

item.title: Tecnologia e planejamento: por que os robôs humanoides devem liderar a próxima fase de exportações da China
item.description: China's early leadership in humanoid robots, driven by strategic investment and forward planning, is expected to raise its share of global manufacturing to 16.5% by 2030, up from 15% today, according to Morgan Stanley. This follows the same pattern seen in electric vehicles and batteries, where China achieved dominance through vertical integration of the supply chain. Growing adoption in factories, universities, and government procurement signals an accelerated expansion of humanoid robotics as a new engine of export growth and technological competitiveness.

item.title: Lula diz que comentou foto de Trump com ex-presidente do Corinthians
item.description: Lula said he commented to Trump about an old photo of the U.S. president with Vicente and Marlene Matheus, former Corinthians president and his wife, taken in an Atlantic City casino in the 1980s. Lula, a Corinthians fan, mentioned he had kept the photo to show Trump, highlighting the former president’s affinity for Brazil. The three-hour meeting was described as positive, with Trump praising Lula as 'very dynamic' and promising future meetings.

item.title: Nota de Flávio sobre operação contra Ciro pega mal no Centrão e alimenta cautela sobre aliança com bolsonarismo
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro's statement regarding the PF operation against Ciro Nogueira was seen as a lack of political solidarity by PP and União Brasil allies, causing discomfort within the Centrão and raising caution about the alliance with Bolsonarism ahead of the 2026 elections. Lawmakers said the remark was interpreted as political abandonment, with one leader stating Flávio 'completely let go of Ciro,' deepening the embarrassment amid the Banco Master investigation.

item.title: Operação contra Ciro Nogueira atrapalha operação de reaproximação do governo com Alcolumbre
item.description: The Federal Police operation targeting Senator Ciro Nogueira, a close ally of Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, disrupted the Lula government’s efforts to rebuild relations with Congress following the defeat in the Jorge Messias STF nomination. Allies viewed the timing as retaliatory, increasing tension and prompting Alcolumbre to distance himself from the Planalto, with expectations of a harder institutional stance ahead.

item.title: Jogo Político: a 'bola de ferro' do bolsonarismo que Tarcísio de Freitas quer, mas não consegue remover dos pés
item.description: The article analyzes how Tarcísio de Freitas, São Paulo governor and Bolsonaro ally, attempts to distance himself from the controversies and radical image of the Bolsonarist movement, yet remains politically trapped by its legacy — symbolized by an 'iron ball' that prevents him from becoming a more moderate or centrist-friendly candidate in the 2026 elections. Despite his technocratic and dialogic governance style, his identity remains intrinsically tied to Bolsonarismo, limiting his political autonomy.

item.title: Lula e Trump: veja o que foi falado e o que ficou de fora da reunião
item.description: Lula and Trump met at the White House to strengthen Brazil-U.S. relations, focusing on economic partnership, trade, and multilateralism. Lula emphasized that the designation of Brazilian factions as terrorist groups and U.S. attacks on payment systems like PIX were not discussed.

item.title: O tempo próprio de Minas
item.description: Minas Gerais plays a central role in national politics as Brazil’s second-largest electoral college, with a socially and regionally diverse electorate that historically mirrors the national average vote. This makes the state a reliable bellwether for national electoral trends. The article highlights this uniqueness but is accessible only to subscribers.

item.title: Leia a íntegra da entrevista de Lula pós-reunião com Trump
item.description: Lula said the meeting with Trump was an important step in strengthening the democratic relationship between Brazil and the United States, emphasizing that the two largest democracies in the hemisphere can serve as a global example. He noted that the U.S. was Brazil’s top trading partner throughout the 20th century but lost ground to China after 2008, urging the U.S. to re-engage with Brazilian exports, especially in infrastructure tenders where Chinese firms now dominate. Lula also highlighted Brazil’s efforts to diversify partnerships through agreements with the EU, Mercosul, EFTA, and Singapore, as global attention returns to Latin America amid current geopolitical tensions.

item.title: Reunião com Trump na Casa Branca foi boa para Lula? Analistas respondem
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva described his three-hour meeting with Donald Trump at the White House as 'very productive,' but analysts question whether the encounter yielded concrete benefits for Brazil. While the tone was cordial, experts note no significant agreements were reached on trade, climate, or immigration, raising doubts about the meeting's political and diplomatic impact for Lula.

item.title: Lula deve amenizar críticas a Trump durante período de negociações após encontro
item.description: President Lula will soften his criticism of Trump during a 30-day period set for tariff negotiations, avoiding offensive remarks after their White House meeting. He proposed the timeline to discuss trade taxes, noting that the average U.S. product tariff in Brazil is 2.7%, though the U.S. claims some reach 12%. Brazil also aims to prevent the U.S. from labeling Brazilian criminal factions as terrorists and halting investigations under Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act.

item.title: Sem citar Ciro, Flávio diz que operação da PF foi correta
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro defended the fifth phase of the Federal Police's Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira without naming him directly. He stated that the allegations in the Master case are serious and that Justice André Mendonça acted correctly in authorizing the operation, emphasizing the need for investigation without political shielding. Flávio also supported establishing a parliamentary inquiry commission to investigate alleged irregularities at Banco Master involving Ciro Nogueira and Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Não dá pra defender outra bandeira, diz Alckmin em vídeo do PSB
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) appeared in a party video defending Brazilian sovereignty, stating that 'it is not possible to defend another flag'. The speech contrasts with 2018 episodes where Bolsonaro supporters were photographed with U.S. flags and then-President Donald Trump backed Bolsonaro, sanctioning Brazilian officials and urging the STF to halt his trial.

item.title: “Um bom homem, um cara inteligente”, diz Trump sobre Lula
item.description: Donald Trump praised Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, calling him 'a good man, a smart guy', and said their conversation focused on trade tariffs, with Brazil requesting relief from U.S.-imposed duties. He described the meeting as positive and emphasized the importance of the bilateral trade relationship.

item.title: Zema critica silêncio de Lula sobre operação da PF que mirou Ciro Nogueira e Banco Master
item.description: Romeu Zema, former governor of Minas Gerais and pre-candidate for president under Novo, criticized President Lula's silence regarding the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, which targeted Senator Ciro Nogueira and Banco Master. Zema highlighted the federal government's lack of transparency regarding a Federal Police operation with significant political targets.

item.title: Trump volta a falar de reunião com Lula e elogia petista
item.description: Donald Trump praised Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following their meeting on Thursday, calling him 'a good man' and 'a smart guy'. He described the meeting as 'very productive' and emphasized plans to boost bilateral trade, including potential tariff relief. Trump also said further meetings would be scheduled in the coming months to address key issues.

item.title: Trump diz que reunião com Lula foi 'ótima' e que o brasileiro é 'um homem bom, um cara inteligente'
item.description: Donald Trump praised Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva following a three-hour meeting at the White House, calling him 'a good man, a smart guy' and emphasizing the productivity of the discussion, which centered on trade and tariffs. Lula reciprocated the praise, describing the meeting as 'positive' and highlighting the strengthening relationship between the two nations, including joking with Trump about not revoking visas for Brazilian football players ahead of the 2026 World Cup hosted by the U.S., Mexico, and Canada.

item.title: França sugere Tebet ou Marina como vice para resolver impasse na chapa de Haddad
item.description: Former minister Márcio França proposed that Simone Tebet (PSB) or Marina Silva (Rede) be chosen as Fernando Haddad’s (PT) running mate for São Paulo governor to resolve the alliance impasse. He suggested balancing the ticket with a governor and female vice-governor, plus a senator and female senator, contrasting it with Tarcísio de Freitas’s all-male ticket. Tebet has rejected the vice role, while Marina has not yet publicly commented.

item.title: Lula en Washington: Trump dice que no invadirá Cuba
item.description: During a meeting at the White House, U.S. President Donald Trump reassured Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva that he does not plan to invade Cuba, despite his frequent aggressive rhetoric on the matter. Lula described the statement as a sign of de-escalation in regional tensions. The meeting took place on Thursday and also covered other items on the bilateral agenda.

item.title: Drible na imprensa, 'clara sintonia' : o que os jornais do mundo disseram sobre encontro de Lula e Trump
item.description: The meeting between Lula and Trump in Washington received wide international coverage, emphasizing the 'clear rapport' between the two leaders despite ideological differences. Outlets such as El País and Le Monde highlighted the symbolic reception gestures, the extended duration of the talks, and the electoral boost for Lula ahead of Brazil's 2026 presidential race.

item.title: Líder da Libertadores, Corinthians garante vaga antecipada nas oitavas
item.description: Corinthians secured an early spot in the 2026 Libertadores round of 16 after Platense and Peñarol drew, giving the Brazilian side 10 points and an unassailable lead in Group E. The team leads the tournament and will have home advantage in knockout matches until a potential semifinal, despite struggling to avoid relegation in the Brazilian league. Their next match is against Peñarol in Montevideo on May 21.

item.title: Relator de minerais críticos diz que Brasil quer investimento “de onde vier”
item.description: The rapporteur of the critical minerals bill, federal deputy Arnaldo Jardim (Cidadania-SP), stated that Brazil seeks to attract investments in critical minerals 'from wherever they come,' following the meeting between Lula and Trump. The bill, approved by the Chamber of Deputies, establishes the National Critical Minerals Policy, provides for a guarantor fund of up to R$5 billion and incentives from 2030 to 2034, with no partner exclusivity. Lula noted Brazil has explored only 30% of its territory and aims to open the sector to investments from the U.S., China, and Europe.

item.title: Janaina sugere Tereza Cristina no comando do PP no lugar de Ciro
item.description: São Paulo councilwoman Janaina Paschoal suggested that Senator Tereza Cristina (PP-MS) should assume the national presidency of the Progressistas (PP) party, replacing Senator Ciro Nogueira (PP-PI), who is under investigation in the fifth phase of Operation Compliance Zero, launched by the Federal Police under STF order. Paschoal stated that Nogueira should step down from party leadership amid the ongoing probe.

item.title: Lula propõe a Trump grupo de trabalho para resolver tarifaço em 30 dias
item.description: Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva proposed to U.S. President Donald Trump the creation of a bilateral working group to resolve, within 30 days, trade disputes involving tariffs between Brazil and the United States. Lula said the group would bring together technical teams from both countries to develop a concrete solution to the so-called 'tariff barrage', with a final proposal to be presented to the presidents after the deadline. The initiative will also cover rare earths, foreign investment, and industrial cooperation.

item.title: Lula conversa com Trump sobre tarifas, combate ao crime organizado e minerais críticos
item.description: President Lula spoke with Donald Trump about tariffs, organized crime, and critical minerals, emphasizing that combating drug trafficking requires economic alternatives, not just military action. He criticized the U.S. strategy of installing foreign military bases without addressing the root causes.

item.title: Brasil e EUA avançam para acordo contra lavagem de dinheiro, diz Durigan
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan stated that Brazil and the United States are close to reaching new agreements on customs and money laundering prevention. The comment followed a meeting between President Lula and President Donald Trump at the White House.
